31449-(R1857).s: The bill approves the 2005 Vienna amendment to the Convention on the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material, extending its scope to domestic use, storage and transport and to nuclear installations. It is an approval law (rijkswet) for the whole Kingdom and enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Is approved for the entire Kingdom.
Wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk.

31700-B.s: This bill sets the 2009 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at 17,421,178 thousand euros and fixes the commitment amount for the general and additional grants at 16,041,947,000 euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum extract describes the municipal fund's financial framework, decentralisation instruments and budget figures without delegating rule-making powers.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and additional grants is fixed for the 2009 grant year at € 16,041,947,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2009 vastgesteld op € 16 041 947 000.

31792-XIV.s: The bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures in the supplementary (Najaarsnota) budget. It sets the effective date of the amendment and does not itself delegate rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statute attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31792-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statute of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting expenditure and commitment ceilings across policy and non-policy articles following the Autumn Memorandum. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift authority between the executive and checks.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2008
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2008

32123-B.s: This bill fixes the 2010 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for the general grant, supplementary grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants in euros. It also sets the entry-into-force rules, including retroactive effect to 1 January if the Staatsblad is published late.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2010 at € 15,626,986,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2010 vastgesteld op € 15 626 986 000.

32222-B.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for general, supplementary, integration and decentralisation grants and adjusting the budget statement in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2009. It is a budgetary adjustment linked to the autumn budget review and does not itself delegate rule-making powers.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for general and supplementary grants is set for the 2009 grant year at EUR 15,657,519,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) ter zake van de algemene uitkeringen en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2009 vastgesteld op € 15 657 519 000.

32395-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles following the Spring Memorandum. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where publication is later.

32395-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport following the Spring Memorandum, shifting appropriations across articles and in total. It also records a transfer to the municipal fund for a pilot enforcing the Drink and Catering Act and a reallocation of a fine target to the supervisory bodies IGZ and NZa.
q: The fine target of EUR 4.2 million was therefore transferred to the revenue articles of the IGZ (EUR 0.4 million) and the NZa (EUR 3.8 million).
De boetetaakstelling van € 4,2 miljoen is daarom overgeboekt naar de ontvangstenartikelen van de IGZ (€ 0,4 miljoen) en de NZA (€ 3,8 miljoen).

32500-C.s: The bill formally sets the 2011 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at a total of €1 142 512 thousand, including commitment amounts for the general and specific grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also fixes the commitment amounts for the general grant (€726 846 000), integration grants (€42 202 000) and decentralisation grants (€373 364 000), and sets the entry-into-force rule.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant etc. is set for grant year 2011 at €726,846,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2011 vastgesteld op € 726 846 000.

32710-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Youth and Family, adjusting appropriations and expenditures across policy articles by the supplementary and closing budget amounts shown. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statement of Youth and Family (XVII) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat vanJeugd en Gezin (XVII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33240-A.s: The bill amends the 2011 expenditure statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund through a supplementary budget (slotwet), changing commitments, expenditures and receipts by programme and article in thousands of euros. It consists of technical and bookkeeping adjustments and adjustments from audit findings, with no new powers or delegations.
33240-A.j: The memorandum states that only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes and changes arising from control findings are included.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes, or changes arising from control findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

33400-C.s: The bill fixes the 2013 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at 1,138,214 thousand euros and sets the commitment amounts for the general and earmarked grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It enters into force on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2013 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

34210-C.s: The bill amends the 2015 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising expenditure and receipts by about 51 million euro and setting new commitment amounts for the general and integration/decentralisation grants. It takes effect from 1 June 2015, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The need has emerged for an amendment to the budget of expenditure and receipts of the provinciefonds for the year 2015.
De noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2015.

34300-C.s: The bill sets the 2016 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at €2,160,334 thousand, including a general grant commitment of €595,313,000 and integration/decentralisation grant commitments of €0 and €1,564,921,000. It also fixes the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the act enters into force on 1 January 2016 or retroactively on that date.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant etc. is set for the 2016 grant year at €595,313,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2016 vastgesteld op € 595.313.000.

34775-XIII.s: This bill sets the 2018 departmental budget statements for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the agency budget statements, and the Animal Health Fund budget for 2018, all in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2018 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34960-XVI.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (first supplementary budget), adjusting spending, commitments and receipts across policy and non-policy articles in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2018 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35095-XVI.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for 2018 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations across policy articles in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment to 1 December 2018 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI)
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI)

35200-C.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by adding supplementary budget amounts and setting the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and the decentralisation grants for 2018. It also fixes the amounts in thousands of euros and sets entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December 2018.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35210-B.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by fixing commitment amounts for general, supplementary, integration and decentralisation grants and adjusting the budget by about 1.01 billion euros. It enters into force on 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this act.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

35300-B.s: This bill fixes the 2020 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at roughly €31.8 billion, in thousands of euros, together with the commitment amounts for the general, integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It enters into force on 1 January 2020 and is accompanied by an explanatory memorandum on fund allocations and budget adjustments.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set at €26,354,315,000 for the 2020 grant year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2020 vastgesteld op € 26.354.315.000.

v.summary: The Raad van State Afdeling advisering reports no remarks on the draft 2020 Gemeentefonds budget bill and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport states that some budgets require amendments, referring to annexes, and transmits the advice as public.

35570-XIX.s: This bill formally adopts the 2021 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Nationaal Groeifonds, setting expenditure and commitments of EUR 4 billion and EUR 1 billion respectively across knowledge development, R&D and innovation, and infrastructure. The explanatory memorandum states that deviations from the articles and contributions to other budgets will be handled through supplementary budgets submitted to parliament to safeguard its budget rights.
35570-XIX.j: The memorandum justifies flexible allocation across articles by the independent committee's advice and says parliament's budget right is safeguarded through supplementary budgets.
q: Deviating allocations across articles and contributions to the budgets of receiving departments will be submitted to parliament via a supplementary budget, to safeguard budget rights.

Afwijkende verdelingen over de artikelen en bijdragen aan de begrotingen van ontvangende departementen worden via een suppletoire begroting voorgelegd aan het parlement, ter borging van het budgetrecht.
d: timing of entry into force tied to another bill

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it had no remarks on the 2021 budget bill for the Nationaal Groeifonds (XIX) and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport confirms this, notes that remarks on one non-blank opinion for the Ministry of Finance are addressed in an annex, and submits technical amendments to several budgets.

36100-C.s: This slotwet amends the 2021 budget statement of the provinciefonds (C) by adjusting the commitment amounts for the general allocation and integration/decentralisation grants, and records the final realised figures. It is a budgetary adjustment bill that takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds (C) for the year 2021
Wij ... hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds (C) voor het jaar 2021

36120-A.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management through a first supplementary budget, changing commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and megaproject lines. The explanatory memorandum explains postponements of several road projects pending a Council of State ruling on nitrogen calculations and transfers from a nitrogen source-measures line.
36120-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by postponing projects pending the Council of State's ruling on nitrogen calculations, with no delegation or new powers claimed.
q: Pending the Council of State's ruling on the nitrogen calculations, the (irrevocable) route decision has been postponed.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de stikstofberekeningen is het (onherroepelijke) Tracébesluit uitgesteld

36200-B.s: This bill sets the 2023 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at about 40.5 billion euro, including commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants. It enters into force on 1 January 2023 and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2023 at € 36,214,354,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2023 vastgesteld op € 36.214.354.000.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft 2023 budget law for the Gemeentefonds (municipal fund) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The accompanying nader rapport from the Minister of Finance transmits the advice and notes that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36455-(R2188).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2018 Protocol amending Council of Europe Convention 108 on the protection of personal data, and for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten the 1981 Convention itself. The explanatory memorandum describes the modernised treaty's supervisory-authority and data-protection rules and how Dutch law (Wiv 2017, UAVG, BES data protection rules) is aligned with them.
36455-(R2188).j: The memorandum justifies the treaty-driven structure of the rules by stressing that the Convention's exceptions for national security are limited, lawful and subject to independent oversight by the CTIVD.
q: The exceptions may moreover not detract from the requirement of independent and effective oversight under national legislation.
De uitzonderingen mogen bovendien geen afbreuk doen aan het vereiste van onafhankelijk en effectief toezicht op grond van nationale wetgeving.

parties: Asks how the convention's flexibility for states to balance data protection against other interests can guarantee a sufficiently high level of protection, and whether intelligence services' processing is adequately controlled and notified.
How is the high level of protection guaranteed if treaty parties easily set aside the right to privacy in favour of other interests?
Hoe wordt het hoge niveau van veiligheid gewaarborgd als verdragspartijen het recht op de persoonlijke levenssfeer makkelijk op zij zetten voor andere belangen?
Asks why the government considers it unnecessary to legally codify the advisory role of the oversight bodies CTIVD and TIB for intelligence services.
The D66 members ask why the government considers it unnecessary to legally codify the advisory role of the oversight bodies CTIVD and TIB.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen waarom de regering het onnodig acht om de adviserende rol van de toezichthouders Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD) en de Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden (TIB) wettelijk vast te leggen.
Asks whether safeguards prevent disproportionate limits on privacy and whether the supervisory authority has sufficient resources and powers to enforce the protocol.
Are there sufficient safeguards built in to prevent this protocol from leading to disproportionate restrictions on citizens' fundamental rights, particularly the right to privacy?
Zijn er voldoende waarborgen ingebouwd om te voorkomen dat dit protocol leidt tot onevenredige beperkingen van de grondrechten van burgers, met name het recht op privacy?
Supports approval but calls for citizen awareness campaigns and questions what follows, arguing protection requires a national cybersecurity law.
According to the faction, the bill is important, but it must be accompanied by a national cybersecurity law.
Volgens de fractie is het voorstel van rijkswet belangrijk, maar dit moet gepaard gaan met een nationale cyberveiligheidswet.
Raises concern that intelligence and security services gain powers over personal data and asks about legal concordance and information exchange within the Kingdom.
This means these services have powers over data that can be classified as personal data.
Dit betekent dat deze diensten bevoegdheden hebben over gegevens die als persoonsgegevens kunnen worden gekwalificeerd.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division issued an opinion on the draft law approving Convention 108+ (the 2018 protocol modifying the Council of Europe data protection treaty) and its protocol for the whole Kingdom, raising points on defence data processing rules, the intelligence services, Caribbean implementation and directly applicable provisions. The government's reply accepted most points, amending the explanatory memorandum and the ministerial regulation on military operations, while declining some changes such as adding statutory consultation duties for the oversight bodies.
concerns: Defence data processing exceptions must be anchored in the law itself under Article 10 of the Constitution, with a delegation basis for detailed rules, rather than left almost entirely to a ministerial regulation.

The ministerial regulation on military operations lacks a basis for excluding a privacy impact assessment and does not set separate rules for special categories of data, which the Convention does not allow without safeguards.
The explanatory memorandum should explain which Convention exceptions the intelligence services act relies on and why the consultation duty of oversight bodies is not statutorily anchored.

Implementation in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom is significantly harder; the explanatory memorandum should set out timeline and approach for legislation and enforcement and justify excluding certain domains.
Articles 6 and 8 of the protocol should be identified as directly applicable provisions alongside Articles 5, 9 and 18.

36625-XIV.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature, the agency budget for the NVWA, and the Animal Health Fund budget. It primarily adjusts appropriations and receipts across policy articles without creating new powers for the executive.
q: We ... have resolved ... The departmental budget statement ... is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat ... wordt gewijzigd

36625-XVI.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2024 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, raising the NVWA budget by 11.2 million euros after a CBb ruling on tobacco sales-bonus fines and adjusting commitments and expenditure across policy articles. It contains no new delegation of rule-making power and only adjusts budgetary appropriations.
36625-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by a court ruling requiring repayment of fines, which raises expenditure above earlier estimates.
q: Following the ruling of the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) on repayment of fines in tobacco sales-bonus cases, the budget of the NVWA is increased.
Naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) in het kader van terugbetaling van boetezaken van verkoopbonussen Tabak wordt het budget van de NVWA verhoogd.

36850-XIV.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature, the NVWA agency budget, and the Animal Health Fund, mainly raising spending by EUR 25 million for compensation to fur farmers after a court ruling. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes the budget mutations and their reasons without delegating rule-making or new powers.
36850-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to a College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven ruling on compensation for fur farmers, not by any delegation or new power.
q: The College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) ruled in lawsuits brought by mink farmers over the compensation for the early ban on fur farming.
Het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) heeft uitspraak gedaan in rechtszaken aangespannen door nertsenhouders over de vergoeding n.a.v. het vervroegd verbod op de pelsdierhouderij

36850-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (second supplementary budget), adjusting spending and commitment appropriations across policy articles such as health, curative care, long-term care and youth care. It also adjusts the budget statement for agencies and the net premium-financed care expenditure figures in the 2026 draft budget.
36850-XVI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to contract timing for care on the BES islands and lower-than-expected uptake of a training subsidy scheme, not by any new executive power.
q: To conclude the care contracts in time, the commitment budget for funding is increased by € 83 million.
Om de zorgcontracten tijdig te kunnen aangaan wordt het verplichtingenbudget op bekostiging met € 83 miljoen opgehoogd.
